text:
Type: plastic dining armchair
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, kitchen, café corner, home office
Style: minimalist, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: molded reinforced polypropylene plastic, matte finish
Colors: light grey, cool grey
Shape: curved rectangular backrest on slim rear posts, short flat armrests, smooth seat, four straight slightly tapered legs, clean lines, light visual weight
Feel: calm, clean, practical, fresh
Goes with: white or light wood tables, grey and concrete tones; modern kitchens, Scandinavian or minimalist dining rooms

product.name: JANINGE
product.description: You can stack the chairs, so they take less space when you're not using them.
